# Known Issues

We work hard to deliver the best developer experience, but some issues may happen that we fail to solve entirely.<br />
You will find here a list of known issues with workarounds.

[Let us know](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/issues/new/choose) if you discover any.

- Ensure you are using the [latest stable version](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/releases)
- Look into [opened bugs](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Atype%3Abug+label%3Alib%3Areact) to check if it has been already reported

## Vite compatibility

If you use [vite](https://vitejs.dev/) you'll need to [define global constant](https://vitejs.dev/config/shared-options.html#define) replacements for `process.env.NODE_ENV`

```js
define: {
  'process.env': {
    NODE_ENV: 'production',
  },
},
```

We are also aware of an **incompatibility with vitest v0.34.x** which requires to mock the `window.btoa` method with our codebase.
In this case, please either

- mock `window.btoa` method (can be done globally with [vi.stubGlobal](https://vitest.dev/api/vi.html#vi-stubglobal))
- update vitest to v1+

## Server Side Rendering

When using SSR (with NextJS or other framework), hydration issues can occur because of how "CSS in JS" works at runtime by generating incremental classnames.
Errors like: `Warning: Prop `className` did not match. Server: "ds-select-dark9" Client: "ds-select-dark11"` may appear.

To deactivate incremental classnames, export an environment variable `AIRBUS_JSS = "SSR"`
For NextJS, you can set this variable in your `next.config.js` (see https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/building-your-application/configuring/environment-variables)

```js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  env: {
    // deactivate incremental classnames with airbus react library
    AIRBUS_JSS: "SSR",
  },
};

module.exports = nextConfig;
```

## Cypress: ComboBox option selection

Reported here : [#2307](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/issues/2307)

"Maximum update depth exceeded" errors may happen in cypress test suites when trying to select any option other than the first in the list of the ComboBox.

```
cy.get('[data-cy="combobox-test-id"]').click()
cy.contains('Second Option').click()
```

**Workaround**

Filter the list and select the first option in the list

```
cy.get('[data-cy="combobox-test-id"]').click()
cy.get('input[type="text"]').type("second")
cy.contains('Second Option').click()
```
